top_stories.title: Judge sides with Anthropic to temporarily block the Pentagon’s ban
top_stories.summary: A federal judge has granted Anthropic a temporary injunction against the U.S. Department of Defense's decision to label the company as a supply-chain risk, which had led to a ban on Pentagon use of its AI services. The ruling allows Anthropic to continue operations while the legal challenge proceeds, highlighting the complexities of supply-chain security in the AI sector.

top_stories.title: Wikipedia bans AI-generated articles
top_stories.summary: Wikipedia has instituted a ban on AI-generated articles after concerns of inaccuracies, potential misinformation, and the risk of undermining editorial standards. The move marks a significant step in how prominent platforms are grappling with the influx of automated content.

top_stories.title: Apple will reportedly allow other AI chatbots to plug into Siri
top_stories.summary: Apple is reportedly planning to open up Siri to integrate with third-party AI chatbots, signaling a significant shift in its strategy toward AI assistants and expanding the capabilities available on iOS devices. This move could potentially make Siri more competitive with AI offerings from rivals.

top_stories.title: Google is making it easier to import another AI’s memory into Gemini
top_stories.summary: Google is rolling out a new feature in its Gemini AI that enables users to import chat history and memory from other AI platforms. The update is aimed at making transitions smoother for users switching from other AI assistants, increasing interoperability and user flexibility.

top_stories.title: Meet the Tech Reporters Using AI to Help Write and Edit Their Stories
top_stories.summary: Wired details how technology reporters are increasingly harnessing AI tools for drafting, fact-checking, and editing, fundamentally changing newsroom workflows. The article explores both the opportunities and ethical challenges this presents for the media industry.

further_links.title: Webtoon is adding AI localization tools to its comics platform
further_links.summary: Webtoon is launching AI-powered localization and translation tools to help comics creators reach international audiences more efficiently.

further_links.title: Why Not Use AI to Cross the Language Barrier in Academic Publishing?
further_links.summary: This article examines the potential and pitfalls of using AI translation tools for academic publishing, highlighting capacity for increasing global research access and lingering concerns on contextual accuracy.

further_links.title: Meta is laying off hundreds of employees as it pours money into AI
further_links.summary: Meta has announced plans to lay off hundreds of employees in a shift to prioritize AI development and related investments.

further_links.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Making audio AI more natural and reliable
further_links.summary: Google DeepMind details improvements to its Gemini 3.1 Flash Live AI models, enhancing naturalness and reliability in audio capabilities.

further_links.title: Chatbot Channels Introduces AI-Based Customer Communication
further_links.summary: Chatbot Channels announces a new AI-driven platform for customer communication, aiming to boost efficiency in e-commerce interactions.

further_links.title: Generative AI in Clinical Trials Market Projected to Grow at
further_links.summary: The clinical trials market is seeing rapid growth in the adoption of generative AI, promising to accelerate processes and data analysis.

further_links.title: Oracle Fusion’s New Agentic AI: Automating the Future of Enterprise Work
further_links.summary: Oracle Fusion introduces new agentic AI features designed to automate more complex enterprise workflows and reshape workplace productivity.

further_links.title: Cosmote launches business cloud ecosystem with GPU-as-a-Service for AI applications
further_links.summary: Telecom operator Cosmote has launched a business cloud service offering GPU-as-a-Service to facilitate scalable AI deployments for enterprises.

further_links.title: Senators Demand to Know How Much Energy Data Centers Use
further_links.summary: Lawmakers are increasing pressure on federal agencies and tech firms to disclose the electricity consumption of data centers, as AI and cloud growth strains infrastructure.

further_links.title: Reimagining the enterprise: From copilots to agentic AI
further_links.summary: This analysis explores how businesses are shifting from simple AI copilots to more advanced agentic AI systems, redefining enterprise workflows.

further_links.title: Wiring the intelligent enterprise for the year ahead - 2026 will be a year of reckoning for AI
further_links.summary: Industry report forecasts 2026 as a pivotal year for integrating AI across enterprises, emphasizing technology, cultural, and operational shifts.

ethan_mollick.title: AI is shaping the real world, and not just with words
ethan_mollick.summary: Ethan Mollick discusses the expanding influence of AI beyond digital boundaries, highlighting real-world impacts seen in fields ranging from hardware to robotics, health, and more. He explores how AI models are increasingly driving physical world changes as companies integrate machine learning into their products and services.
